description: Corrections to what AWS's Service Authorization Reference says these operations are authorized as, where a live call disagrees (scripts/iam.ts). Each `reason` is the evidence.

value.reason: Image Builder serves scan aggregations from Amazon Inspector, so the API authorizes the dependent inspector2 action too — without it the call fails with AccessDeniedException even when the imagebuilder action is granted.
